Title: Festive Umbraco
Description: Temporarily transforms the Umbraco backoffice into a festive experience during date ranges you choose. Eight themes — Christmas, Halloween, New Year, Diwali, Valentine's Day, Easter, St Patrick's Day, and Thanksgiving — each with its own subtle background effect, occasional themed cameo, and celebratory toast on publish. Run a single theme for one occasion, or plan the whole year ahead with a schedule that switches itself over. Backoffice only, off by default, and it never touches your content or your front end.
